ma.startGyroscope(Object object)

Start listening for the gyroscope data.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
interval String normal No Execution frequency of the callback function for listening to the gyroscope data
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object interval
Valid Value Description
game Suitable callback frequency for updating games (about every 20 ms).
ui Suitable callback frequency for updating UIs (about every 60 ms).
normal Common callback frequency (about every 200 ms).

Sample Code

ma.startGyroscope({
  interval: 'ui',
  success: function(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail: function(err) {
    console.log(err);
  }
});
